submit.title: 🧭 How to file D212 — step-by-step guide
submit.subtitle: Source: ANAF D212 Pre-fill Guide v2026.1 (May 2026). This tool is a calculator — the actual filing goes through ANAF.
submit.recommended: ⭐ Recommended flow: DUF portal (online, in SPV)
submit.recommendedFor: For whom: any individual with an SPV account (username+password, NOT digital certificate). Works for investors, freelancers (PFA), multi-CNP — all cases.
submit.step1: Log in to anaf.ro/declaratii/duf with your SPV credentials.
submit.step3: Walk through the step-by-step wizard. ANAF shows what it already knows about you (D205 withholding income, C168 rental contracts, prior D212). For each item choose: „Include with amounts” / „Include without amounts” / „Do not include”.
submit.step4: ⚠️ Foreign income (cap14) MAY NOT BE PRE-FILLED. Add it manually in the DUF web form after the wizard.
submit.step5: After the wizard you are in a fully editable web form. Navigate in the left menu to „Realized income” and fill in fields using the table below.
submit.step6: Click the red „Generate PDF for filing” button (right panel). The system validates and produces a submission-ready PDF.
submit.step7: The PDF is filed electronically through SPV. You receive the receipt in the „Messages” section of SPV.
submit.dufCaveat: 💡 Note: DUF pre-fill is not available when authenticating with a qualified digital certificate — only with SPV username+password.
submit.fallback: 🛠️ Alternative flow: smart PDF (Adobe Reader, no interactive SPV)
submit.fallbackFor: For whom: users who prefer offline work or can't access the DUF wizard. More laborious, but supports direct XML import.
submit.fbStep1: Download the official D212 PDF from anaf.ro/declaratii. Save to disk, do NOT open in browser.
submit.fbStep2: Open the PDF exclusively in Adobe Acrobat Reader (Chrome/Edge can't run XFA forms).
submit.fbStep3: Export our XML: „Tax Calculation” tab → 📤 „Export D212 XML (skeleton)” button.
submit.fbStep4: In Adobe Reader, find the „Import data” button (top of the form area) and select our XML.
submit.fbStep5: Fill in the missing data manually: name, CNP, IBAN, freelance details if applicable.
submit.fbStep6: Click „Validate” in the PDF — fix flagged errors.
submit.fbStep7: Save the completed PDF and submit it through SPV („Submit declarations” section).
submit.fbWarning: ⚠️ This flow does NOT benefit from automatic DUF pre-fill. You risk mis-entering data ANAF already has (D205, D112). Recommended only if DUF doesn't work for you.
submit.crossRefValidateText: DUF XML validation and the „Values to enter in DUF” table have been moved to the „🔬 Validate & Prepare D212” tab to clearly separate the procedural flow (this guide) from the data-working flow (validation and preparation).
submit.valuesTitle: 📋 Values to enter into the DUF form for the current year
submit.valuesSubtitle: These values come directly from our calculations. Copy them into the corresponding DUF web form fields under „Realized income”.
submit.responsibilityText: Per the ANAF Guide: „Responsibility for the correctness of the information in the declaration belongs entirely to the taxpayer. Pre-fill is an assistance tool, NOT a confirmation of the real tax situation.”
submit.responsibilityNote: Verify our values before entering them in DUF. This tool is an open-source calculator, not a substitute for tax advice.
submit.deadlineBonus: 15 April 2026 — deadline for the 3% bonification (filing + full payment). If eligible, tick the bonification option in DUF.
submit.deadlineFinal: 25 May 2026 — standard D212 filing deadline for fiscal year 2025.

validate.title: 🔬 Validate & Prepare D212
validate.subtitle: One place for: (1) validation against the DUF XML, (2) the table of values to enter in the portal, (3) per-payer D205 detail (manually entered from the portal). All data stays local — nothing is written to disk.
validate.importSubtitle: Download the XML from the DUF portal (with your pre-filled data) and upload it here. We validate row by row what ANAF knows vs what we compute from broker PDFs.
validate.d205Subtitle: Why manual: The DUF XML carries only the aggregated cass_ven_inv total (e.g. 513,258 lei) for CASS, NOT the per-payer breakdown. Per-payer details (XTB / ING / SALT etc.) are visible only in the portal under „Source detail → All sources”. Enter them here manually so we can cross-check against your broker PDFs.
validate.d205HowToCollect: 📖 How do I collect these details from the DUF portal? (2 paths)
validate.d205PathA: Path A — in the „Preluare/modificare date” wizard
validate.d205PathA1: On the „Preluare/modificare date” page (after clicking „Precompletare (recomandat)”), the toggle in the upper right shows „Modific/Vizualizez”.
validate.d205PathA2: For each step of the wizard there is a blue „Sursa informațiilor în detaliu” button (under the progress bar).
validate.d205PathA3: Click it → modal with 2 tabs: „Acest pas” (just the current source) and „Toate sursele” (cumulative D205 list — what you need for the breakdown).
validate.d205PathB1: On the same precompletion page, switch the upper-right toggle to „Centralizator”.
validate.d205PathB2: Click „Deschide toate” to expand all income sources.
validate.d205PathB3: Each source shows a „Sursa informațiilor în detaliu” button (same modal with „Toate sursele”).
validate.d205PathB4: The „Toate sursele” table includes: Payer fiscal code, Payer company name, Income category (d205/C168) — codes like 09 (interest), 26 (capgains ≥1y), 27 (capgains <1y), Gross income, Tax.
validate.d205ScreenshotNote: Anonymized reference screenshots. Real amounts and identifying details have been masked.
validate.d205Step1: In the DUF wizard, after pre-fill, each income source has a „Source detail” button.
validate.d205Step2: Click it → a modal dialog with a „All sources” tab shows the full D205 table.
validate.d205Step3: For each row: Payer fiscal code, Company name, Income category (09 interest, 26 capgains ≥1y, 27 capgains <1y), Gross income, Tax.
validate.d205Step4: Once you have the data, use the buttons below: + Add row for manual entry, or 📋 Paste from clipboard if you copied straight from the table.
validate.d205ClearConfirm: Clear all D205 rows for the current year?
validate.d205Empty: No D205 rows entered. Use the buttons above.

income.stockUploadHint: Upload your Stock Award Document in the Import Document tab to populate this table.
income.deductionNote: Tax is applied on NET income after 40% flat-rate deduction (Art. 84/72 Cod Fiscal). Example: 10,000 gross - 40% deduction (4,000) = 6,000 net taxable × 10% = 600 tax. The deduction covers all expenses (no receipts needed).

income.tradesUploadHint: Upload Trade Confirmation PDFs in the Import Document tab. Multiple files are supported.

dcl.cgFormulaEsppShort:
Taxable = [Sale (USD) − Purchase (USD) − Fees (USD)] × {rate} − Amount taxed as salary (RON)**
Tax = Taxable × 10%

Taxable = [Sale (USD) − Fees (USD)] × {rate} − Amount taxed as salary (RON)**
Tax = Taxable × 10%

dcl.cgNote2: ** Amount taxed as salary = values from payslip under "stock withholding", "SPP gain BIK" or "Stock award BIK".
